structs.name: CMoon
structs.basis: RTTI 2768. The title screen's models: nocedit's CMoon holds one CKeyFramedModel (22,232 bytes there); BW's holds three of 920 from +0x8, 8 + 3 x 920. The ctor constructs them at +0x8, +0x3a0, +0x738 and zeroes +0; the dtor destroys the three in reverse. +0x4 (nocedit's rotation_phase) is never read: the rotation is in globals.

fields.name: is_loaded
fields.basis: init (00521c50) loads only while 0 and sets 1; free (00521d50) unloads only while set and clears it

fields.name: models
fields.basis: init loads titletwana/b/c.kfm into +0x8, +0x3a0, +0x738 (or taylor_head.kfm into +0x8 alone); render (00521e40) draws the three; free releases them

structs.name: CDemonMission
structs.basis: No RTTI. The static instance at 0x1d2c900 runs to the next global at 0x1d33b20 (0x7220), and the last field, the actor lookup table at +0x1460, holds 6000 (writeFile asserts at 5999), ending there. nocedit's editor fields at +0x10..+0x43 (camera, viewport, selection, editor render flags) are gone; the set names grew from 4 to 16 and moved ahead of the flags.

fields.name: current_set_index
fields.basis: loadSet (0051b610) returns when the index is already current, else stores it; buildActiveSetActorList compares actors' area_id with it

fields.name: num_sets
fields.basis: readMissionFile scans it, then that many set names; clearMissionData zeroes it

fields.name: set_names
fields.basis: readMissionFile reads each name at +0x8 + i * 0x100; loadSet passes +0x8 + index * 0x100 to CDemonSet load; +0x1008 is the next field

fields.name: is_in_editor
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; loadSet builds the full set actor list when set, the active list (buildActiveSetActorList) when not

fields.name: mission_version_num
fields.basis: readMissionFile scans it first and rejects versions above 7; the ctor sets -1

fields.name: has_inventory_actors
fields.basis: ctor and clearMissionData zero it, at nocedit's offset + 0x1004 as the other flags

fields.name: teleport_requested
fields.basis: setTeleportTarget sets 1; process clears it once the hero is moved; the ctor zeroes it. New in BW.

fields.name: mission_name
fields.basis: ctor and clearMissionData clear the first byte; first_actor follows at +0x1118

fields.name: first_actor
fields.basis: buildActiveSetActorList walks next_actor from it; the ctor zeroes it

fields.name: last_actor
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it beside first_actor; nocedit's +0x54c + 3024

fields.name: pending_teleport
fields.basis: process copies +0x1120..+0x112c into the current hero's location when area_id (+0x112c) >= 0, loads that set if it differs, then sets area_id -1 and the position 0

fields.name: delete_queue_count
fields.basis: markActorToDelete appends at it and asserts below 100; process removes each queued actor and zeroes it

fields.name: delete_queue_actors
fields.basis: markActorToDelete stores the actor at +0x1134 + count * 4; process passes it to removeActor

fields.name: delete_queue_flags
fields.basis: markActorToDelete stores its second argument at +0x12c4 + count * 4; process passes it to removeActor

fields.name: prepared_set_index
fields.basis: nocedit's actors_prepared flag, now a set index: prepareAllActors stores current_set_index, loadSet prepares again when they differ, the ctor sets -1

fields.name: next_inventory_actor
fields.basis: ctor and clearMissionData zero it; nocedit's +0x888 + 3024

fields.name: actor_lookup_count
fields.basis: writeFile zeroes it, appends to the table at it and asserts below 6000

fields.name: actor_lookup_table
fields.basis: writeFile stores each actor at +0x1460 + count * 4

structs.name: CInventory
structs.basis: No RTTI. CHero holds three: its ctor (004ce240) constructs them 0x624 apart from +0x2437c and its dtor destroys +0x24fc4 and the two below; the ctor here (004da760) clears the 5-entry arrays up to +0x624. The items are split into 5 groups, each with its own selected item and weapon (cycleWeaponOfSameClass, selectItem). Everything from item_count to render_mode_flag sits 8 higher than in nocedit, the tail is re-ordered, and +0xc (zeroed by ctor and clear) and +0x338..+0x33f are never read.

fields.name: battery_charge
fields.basis: ctor sets 100.0

fields.name: owner
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's offset (5 sightings at delta 0)

fields.name: show_compass
fields.basis: the HUD render (004dd9b0) draws compass_background and the hero's heading only while set; ctor and clear zero it

fields.name: item_count
fields.basis: clear removes items while it is positive; cycleWeaponOfSameClass bounds its loops by it

fields.name: items
fields.basis: clear removes +0x14 until empty; cycleWeaponOfSameClass reads +0x14 + i * 4

fields.name: item_angles
fields.basis: initialize fills +0x1a4 .. +0x334 with random angles

fields.name: save_version
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's +0x32c + 8

fields.name: weapon_highlight_timer
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's +0x338 + 8 (26 aligned sightings, +0x338..+0x44c)

fields.name: item_highlight_timer
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's +0x33c + 8

fields.name: inventory_display_timer
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's +0x340 + 8

fields.name: message_display_timer
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; the HUD render reads it; nocedit's +0x344 + 8

fields.name: ammo_detail_timer
fields.basis: nocedit's +0x348 + 8

fields.name: message_text
fields.basis: ctor clears its first byte; nocedit's +0x34c + 8

fields.name: render_mode_flag
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's +0x44c + 8

fields.name: light_gun_ptr
fields.basis: ctor zeroes it; nocedit's +0x454 + 4

fields.name: cached_ammo_count
fields.basis: initialize zeroes it; nocedit's +0x45c

fields.name: preserve_items
fields.basis: clear passes (+0x460 == 0) to each item's removal and then zeroes it; nocedit's +0x450 + 16

fields.name: ammo_ptr
fields.basis: initialize stores createActorByName("CAmmo") here; clear releases it

fields.name: current_group
fields.basis: indexes selected_items and selected_weapons; findItemByName and hasItemOfClass match items whose group equals it

fields.name: item_groups
fields.basis: ctor zeroes +0x46c .. +0x5fc; compared with current_group per item

fields.name: selected_items
fields.basis: +0x5fc + current_group * 4 is compared with items and tested for 0; ctor and clear zero the 5

fields.name: selected_weapons
fields.basis: cycleWeaponOfSameClass reads and stores +0x610 + current_group * 4 with a CWeapon it finds among the items
